kjv: the valley of the shadow of death
note: ge' tsalmawet: tsalmawet is "deep darkness" (see Job 3:5); "shadow of death" is the traditional etymology, which narrows a dark valley of any danger to the moment of dying.

kjv: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever
mine: and I shall return to the house of Yahweh for length of days
note: MT weshavti "and I shall return" (shuv); the LXX/Syriac read weyashavti "I shall dwell", which the KJV follows; le'orekh yamim is "for length of days", i.e. all my life, not "for ever".
